svg.title: As-built AWS VPC architecture
svg.desc: A VPC spanning two availability zones. AZ-a has a public subnet with a running NAT gateway and bastion instance, and a private subnet with a running app instance. AZ-b has an equivalent public and private subnet pair that are provisioned but currently unused. An internet gateway sits at the top of the VPC, connected to the public internet. A legend notes that access is via SSM Session Manager only, with no SSH, and that VPC Flow Logs are enabled.
svg.text: Access: SSM Session Manager only (no SSH) · VPC Flow Logs: enabled
